''See also: [[binding Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A binding is a crystallized [[technique]] that serves as the essential core of a [[construct]]. While [[scripts]] are used to control various components or add properties to an object, the binding provides the actual heart and soul of a [[construct]]; without one, an object is merely a scripted item made of material. Bindings possess significant weight and depth, often described as being more substantial than simple drawings or [[scripts]], comparable to a statue or a pearl. In practice, bindings can take many forms, such as spiraling drills, [[white light]], or even organic shapes resembling hearts or stars. They can be embedded into physical vessels by [[Soulsmiths]], who use [[madra]] to merge the binding with a framework. The functionality of a binding is often determined by how [[madra]] is circulated through it, and some advanced bindings can produce multiple different techniques or even fuse several techniques into a single, perfected unit. Bindings are highly sensitive to the type of [[madra]] used with them; for instance, a binding might change its effect or become damaged if it absorbs incompatible energy. Some bindings are specifically designed to devour [[madra]], such as hunger binding{{!}}hunger bindings, which can be used to pull power from others. While most bindings are single-purpose, rare and powerful versions—such as those found in [[Dreadgods]]—can possess multiple integrated functions and maintain their own balance.}}
